svg.title: 2027 Autonomous Navigation: workstream pipeline
svg.text: 2027 Autonomous Navigation · who does what, what goes in, what comes out
Read left → right = camera-only → IMU → GPS. Top-to-bottom lanes = one person each. Every lane can start today using its own stand-in input.
HEDGIE · offline SLAM & semantic maps (works on files only: no camera, no ROS needed)
WOBBLES · sensors, TF, recording (the data hub: everyone else depends on this output)
BEDRAWN · maps, costmaps, Nav2 (replay / simulation only, motors OFF)
IN: LIVE camera or SVO replay
camera is bolted on the rover
SESSION FOLDER (files on disk): Wobbles → Hedgie
REAL ZED TOPICS + TF (live or bag replay): swap in for the synthetic source
OFFLINE MAP EXPORT (optional, later): Hedgie → Bedrawn
map candidate for Bedrawn's map / static layer ←
WORK TOGETHER · the five sync points, in order
one small skeleton PR from main,
TF CONTRACT · every arrow has exactly ONE publisher (two publishers of map → odom = rover 'jumps')
Out of scope: no motor commands. Legacy main.py stays a standalone ZED prototype. Proof = RViz + replay/simulation, not a live drive.
